description: Explicit UART acceptance-fixture wiring configuration; not a claim extracted from the UART specification. Review this integration configuration before using it on another design.
statement: The acceptance fixture selects DATA_BUS_WIDTH_8, drives wb_clk_i with a 10 ns testbench clock, binds wb_rst_i as active high, and ties unused wb_sel_i and modem inputs cts_pad_i, dsr_pad_i, ri_pad_i and dcd_pad_i to zero.
